title: Require Service Public Consumer Sealing
forbids: a literal module-loading edge from packages, plugins, apps, or mods to a standalone service private alias or a syntactically visible services/<owner>/src/service path
why: A standalone service crosses a foreign consumer boundary through its deliberate public package exports. Private aliases and physical implementation paths remain owned by the service package.
remediate: Import the service public package face instead of a #<owner>-service alias or a literal path that visibly enters services/<owner>/src/service.
message: Standalone service implementation trees are private to their owning package.
